scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.test:diagnostics: tsc --outDir .tmp-tests --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --types node netlify/functions/_shared/diagnostics.ts tests/diagnostics.test.ts && node --test .tmp-tests/tests/diagnostics.test.js
scripts.test:notifications: tsc --outDir .tmp-tests --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck --types node netlify/functions/_shared/notifications.ts tests/notifications.test.ts && node --test .tmp-tests/tests/notifications.test.js
